Monthly announcement for an industrious handover
Please take a moment

Travelers with companion animals should check in early and keep all papers ready.

Aurelia Skyways Companion Animal Travel Desk
Travel with your pet made simple

We want every trip to feel calm for you and kind for your animal. Our team guides travelers through the steps, checks carrier fit, and helps keep each pet secure from check-in to handoff. The ground team moves carriers carefully between services, and the desk stays ready to answer common concerns in plain words.

Please keep collars, labels, and health papers easy to reach before you arrive. If your pet needs special handling, let the desk know as soon as you can so the staff can prepare the right support. <<FACT F029>> The lounge team also keeps an eye on comfort needs, and <<FACT F001>> so travelers can move ahead with less worry.

If you are traveling with a cat or dog, bring familiar items that help them stay settled. A clean carrier, a little water, and a calm voice can make the whole process smoother for everyone.

For help with companion animal travel, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
